## About me

I am a linguist working at the intersection of language variation, corpus linguistics and distributional semantics. I currently teach Italian linguistics at KU Leuven, where I earned my PhD in Linguistics in February 2026 with a dissertation on **semantic factors in grammatical alternations using distributional semantics techniques**, supervised by Prof. Dr. Benedikt Szmrecsanyi.

My research interests include:

- Variationist sociolinguistics and probabilistic grammar
- Language variation and change
- Corpus linguistics and advanced statistical methods
- Lexical and distributional semantics
- Usage-based and cognitive approaches to language
- Morphosemantics and language creativity
- Large language models from a linguistic perspective
